messages:
evan: kicked off a recompute for EU+NA hourly aggregates (job id rb-0xc1). Early run shows a cluster of 'validation_fail' errors on merged partitions. Need quick sync on console visibility and SLA messaging.

maya: what kind of validation_fail? schema mismatch, checksum, or overlapping writes?

ev an: mostly overlapping writes + a couple checksum mismatches. ops-bot preflight: validation_fail_count=9/640.

ops-bot: job rb-0xc1 status: RUNNING
  completed_shards: 120/640
  validation_fail_count: 9
  quarantined: 6

chris: console should not show a single percent for progress when quarantined exists. Suggest split bars: completed | in_flight | quarantined. Also a small text badge "quarantined shards require operator review".

maya: we also need a clear SLO blurb in console: "This recompute is best-effort; quarantined shards pause automated progress until reviewed." PMs get annoyed by silent pauses.

ev an: ops decision: auto-retry quarantined shards once in a low-priority lane, then escalate to operator. Cap retries at 1.

infra-oncall: agree on cap. Also add a ledger event for retries with fields attempt,timestamp,trigger. Simple string entries are fine.

chris: small API request: add job_metadata.quarantined_count and job_metadata.effective_eta which excludes quarantined shards by default. UI can show an "include quarantined in ETA" toggle.

maya: runbook note for respawn command:
```
# respawn quarantined shards into priority lane
replayctl respawn --job rb-0xc1 --shards eu-21,na-03 --priority low --max-attempts 1
```

ev an: also want to surface compute headroom before allowing operator-initiated escalation. If headroom < 15% block and show tooltip.

infra-oncall: will add metric headroom_percent. Console should grey the escalate button below threshold.

chris: alerts: slack at quarantined_fraction >= 0.02 for 5m, pager at >= 0.08 for 10m.

maya: I'll implement the UI bits: split progress bar, ETA toggle, and a small link to ledger. Plan: backend PR for metadata fields today, UI PR tomorrow.

ev an: decision for this run: let auto-retry happen for small shards, do not escalate more until ledger entries show retries exhausted. ops will monitor.

ops-bot: job rb-0xc1 update: 3 quarantined shards auto-retried -> 2 succeeded, 1 moved to operator queue. attempts_remaining for that shard: 0

infra-oncall: if we see repeated checksum failures on same partition ranges, file an ingest pipeline bug and pause auto-retries on those ranges.

maya: will post a short note to #product after UI deploy to explain quarantined state and new ETA behavior.

ev an: thanks team. ping here if anything regresses. :rocket:
